_comment: DEPLOYMENT NOTE: hellouchit.com serves from GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare,
so this file is INERT — none of these headers reach visitors today. It is
kept correct so a future move to Vercel is a no-op rather than an outage.
The headers that actually apply in production are Cloudflare Transform Rules;
docs/security-headers.md is the source of truth and mirrors the values here.
CSP NOTE: 'unsafe-inline' is deliberate, not laziness. The site has 93 inline
<script> blocks (every diagnostic's Diag.run({...}) and every decision tree's
window.TREE = {...}), 7 inline event handlers and 828 inline style attributes.
A nonce-based policy requires per-request header generation, which no static
host can do. Tightening this means first moving that config into external .js
files — a worthwhile refactor, but a refactor, not a header change.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.google-analytics.com https://analytics.google.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://*.googletagmanager.com https://stats.g.doubleclick.net https://www.google.com https://cloudflareinsights.com; upgrade-insecure-requests
